cable-end.note: the CABLE end: tube, bayonet cap and BOTH its O-rings. The radial 22 x 2 on the cap's spigot seals against the tube's Ø25.5 COLLAR; the gland ring in the outer face seals the gland body to the cap.

parts.note: printed ASA; the cable end now carries a COLLAR -- material added INWARD to Ø25.5 H7, reamed, 12 mm long, standing 0.85 mm proud of the Ø27.2 bore with a 45 deg lead above it. It is NOT a counterbore: the old Ø27.3 had to be larger than the tube bore, which is exactly what forced a 24 ID ring
bayonet, 2 lugs, M3 lock screw. Spigot reaches into the reamed bore

22 x 2 EPDM 70 -- the ring ON HAND. Drawn at its INSTALLED section: 2.15% stretch onto the Ø22.473 groove root, 23.5% squeeze against the Ø25.5 collar. Catalogue cord is enough (11.2 of 15 tolerance points); the 24 x 1.5 it replaces needed micrometer-sorted rings
in the cap's OUTER face notch, squeezed by the gland flange -- a different seal from the radial one

probe.note: THE WHOLE PROBE, as it assembles. Monobody (head and tube are one printed part) with the membrane stack at the wet end and the bayonet cap at the cable end. Both cable-end O-rings and the membrane bed's two are drawn at their INSTALLED sections, so what you see is how they sit in service, not free.
